description: Defines a Note entity class mapped to the 'notes' table in the database. Contains fields for id, ownerId, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt with relevant JPA annotations, including lifecycle callbacks for timestamp management.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity representing a note with optional owner, title, content, and timestamps. Includes lifecycle methods for managing timestamps.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to initialize createdAt and updatedAt timestamps before persisting a new Note.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update the updatedAt timestamp before updating an existing Note.

methods.name: Note
methods.description: Constructor to initialize ownerId, title, and content fields.
